about.text: A moist, soft, creamy, surface-ripened cow's-milk cheese first made in the late 18th century in Camembert, Normandy. Most Camembert is now made outside Normandy with pasteurised milk, while the AOC Camembert de Normandie must use raw milk.

sources.text: Soft, surface-ripened cow cheese, its late 18th-century origin, and the raw-milk AOC rule.
